purpose: Assign an evidence-backed category to one captured earliest failure without guessing a repair.
trigger: Use after EX-12 has produced an ordered earliest_failure record.

inputs.name: earliest_failure
inputs.description: Captured first error, stage, source location, run reference, and observed state.

inputs.name: error_category_definitions
inputs.description: Versioned category definitions and evidence predicates.

preconditions: earliest_failure has original error text and first stage.
Category definitions are versioned and available.

outputs.name: failure_classification
outputs.description: One category, supporting fields, confidence, and unresolved items.

outputs.name: needs_manual_review
outputs.description: True when evidence does not distinguish one category.

postconditions: Exactly one category is returned only when its predicate is satisfied.
Ambiguous evidence yields needs_manual_review and no repair prescription.

implementation.target_environment: SpaceClaim V21-compatible contract reasoning; no host execution is performed by this operation.
implementation.notes: The reusable artifact is this candidate guidance contract; no executable implementation is claimed. Classification gate only; no category-specific repair execution is claimed.

ambiguity_checks: Use only the declared identity, state, or geometry predicates; do not substitute recorded FaceN/BodyN aliases or an arbitrary collection member.
If the declared evidence cannot make the target unique, return needs_manual_review and do not continue.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Not applicable; the operation does not mutate model topology.

failure_modes.condition: Evidence supports multiple categories or none.
failure_modes.detection: Predicates tie or no predicate matches.

failure_modes.condition: A repair is included in classification output.
failure_modes.safe_state: Discard repair payload; retain classification only.

recovery.action: Return needs_manual_review and request the missing discriminator.
Re-run with repair fields excluded; select ER-02..ER-10 separately.

validation.method: Validate this object against operation-template.schema.json and compare operation_id with the EX/ER catalog slug.
validation.expected: The object is schema-valid, remains candidate, and declares exactly one bounded execution_recovery action.

validation.method: Read the linked single-operation guidance and compare its input, result, procedure, and rejection fields with this contract.
validation.expected: The contract exposes every declared input/output and preserves refusal, recovery, and needs_manual_review behavior.

validation.method: Use the operation-specific controller or host-tool adapter only after the required authorization and target-state gates are independently satisfied.
validation.expected: Exactly one category is returned only when its predicate is satisfied.

evidence_level.notes: Guidance interface checked on host; synthetic independent application reviewed. No controller event or repaired geometry was observed for this guide.
